|                                                                                 | Twin phase                                                                      | Twin phase models should be connected as shown (the twin phase oven requires a three phase supply, utilising L1 & L2 as two separate single phases, L3 is not used). 30A models are fitted with a red 32A plug to IEC 60309 (EN 60309). Connected to a dedicated RCD (GFCI) protected supply, with appropriate circuit breaker as detailed above.                                    |

Connected to a dedicated RCD (GFCI) protected supply, with appropriate circuit breaker as detailed above. |
